description: Single-security K-line for **stocks and A-share indices** (daily by default; `minute=true` + one `date` for intraday). Multi-code: `bars_batch` (stocks only). Indices are detected from the code: `SSE:000xxx`, `SZSE:399xxx`, `BSE:899xxx`. ⚠️ The exchange prefix decides it — `SSE:000001` is the Shanghai Composite, `SZSE:000001` is 平安银行; pass `kind` to override. To measure a stock against its market, call twice over the same window (stock + index) — `index_snapshot` has no history. Index minute bars are capped at 7 calendar days. Indices add `pct_change` and have no turnover-rate or market-cap field.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

code.description: Single canonical code — stock (e.g. SSE:600519) or A-share index (e.g. SSE:000001, SZSE:399006, BSE:899050)

days.description: Daily lookback (ignored when from/to or minute mode are set)

from.description: YYYY-MM-DD inclusive start (daily mode; overrides days)

kind.description: Override the stock/index guess made from the code. Omit unless the code is one the rule gets wrong — SSE:000xxx / SZSE:399xxx / BSE:899xxx are read as indices, everything else as stocks.

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD inclusive end (daily mode; overrides days)

name: chart
